title: Jet Fuel VS Diesel VS Gasoline how they burn and what color are they.
summary: A hands-on comparison of how jet fuel, diesel, heating oil, kerosene, avgas and gasoline burn and what color they are. It shows that gasoline ignites more easily than jet fuel.
why: HN cites it as a practical demonstration that kerosene-type fuels are hard to ignite compared with gasoline.

quote.text: Great practical demonstration of the different flammability characteristics of some common fuels.
